name: time-slider
title: Time Slider
description: Step a chart through time: a play button, a slider with one stop per frame (a year, a survey wave, a season), and the current frame printed large beside them. Any chart goes inside: the slider owns which frame is showing, and the chart is drawn for that…
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/time-slider

Installed to `components/ui/charts/time-slider.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/charts/time-slider';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/time-slider

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
